What is an AI Ad Generator?
An AI ad generator is a tool that turns your product details, text prompt, or campaign brief into ready-to-use video ads and static ads. Instead of designing from scratch, you enter a short input, and the AI generates layouts, headlines, videos, visuals, and ad copy you can edit and export.
How does an AI Ad Generator work?
It combines several AI techniques. Natural language processing reads your prompt. Generative AI models trained on large sets of ads produce the visuals and copy. Machine learning ranks and refines the variations. The result is a finished ad assembled from your input, which you can then customize.
What is generative AI, and how does it create ads?
Generative AI is a type of artificial intelligence that produces images, video, and text rather than just analyzing existing data. In an AI ad generator, generative models trained on large datasets take your text prompt, product link, or image and generate original ad creatives, copy, and videos from it. Predis.ai combines several such models, including Google's Veo and Gemini and ByteDance's Seedance for video, with proprietary models tuned for advertising, so the output is built to convert, not just to look good.
Can I use the AI Ad generator for free?
Yes, you can use the 7-day free trial. After the trial period, you can choose from our various subscription plans to continue using the tool.
Are the AI generated ads licensed for commercial use?
Yes, the ads and creatives generated with our AI ad generator are licensed for commercial use. You can use the generated content in your ad campaigns and on various social platforms. Check our terms and conditions for more details on content usage and licensing.
Can I make Instagram and Facebook ads?
Yes, you can make Facebook ad creatives, Instagram ads, video ads, and ads with our AI ad generator. You can make ads for all popular social media platforms.
Can I edit the ad templates?
Yes, you can edit the generated ads and videos. You can also import your ad designs in Predis.ai.
Can I make ads in multiple languages?
Yes, you can make ads in more than 19 languages. You can select input and output language while creating content. You can also use the app in different languages.
Can I use Predis.ai for ad serving on ad networks?
You can export the ad, videos in full HD 1080p at 60 FPs and upload them in your ad campaigns.
Can I create ad copies using Predis?
Yes, you can generate ad copy with our AI. You can choose to generate ad copy only with our AI chat feature.
Can I use my own ad templates?
Yes, you can import your designs and templates in Predis.ai. You can also import custom social media templates.
